A new digital
first impression.

A private, independent website preview for Wellness Origin Spa. The official business website has not been changed.

What has changed

A complete static website now preserves the 29 published sitemap paths, replaces the old machine-readable staging identity, gives every page unique metadata, adds clear service links and breadcrumbs, and uses original supplied images in lightweight responsive formats.

Designed to be explored

Browse service categories, choose a treatment interest, open practical FAQs and navigate the same information on desktop or mobile. Important content is available in the initial HTML. Motion is subtle and respects reduced-motion preferences.

Intentionally private

This preview is access-protected and marked noindex. Its empty preview sitemap is deliberate. A production sitemap, a launch checklist and a redirect map are prepared in the source package; production crawling and indexing must be enabled only during an authorized launch.

What still needs the business

Confirm prices, membership terms, provider credentials, device details, treatment suitability and medical claims. The live WordPress CSS issues, rewards automation, business profiles, analytics, booking transactions and financing systems are outside this preview. No rankings, indexing or Core Web Vitals outcome is claimed.

Original assets, honest context

The photographs and logo are from the supplied November 6, 2026 website collection. Some are promotional or illustrative images previously used by the business; they are not asserted to show its actual clients or staff. No new AI-generated imagery is used. Rights and final copy require business approval before a public launch.
